howto.title: How to play
howto.0.title: The goal
howto.0.text: You have two goals: reach the company's productivity target (65%) and complete your own secret objective. If the company closes everybody loses: no winner, no ranks.
howto.1.title: Tasks
howto.1.text: Each block has two tasks. You hold some of the information, your partner holds the rest: talk, then enter the right answer. Some options are marked 'sabotage'; each one leaves an incident record.
howto.2.title: Phone and text
howto.2.text: In the office, private talk is one-to-one; in meetings everyone hears everyone. Typing is a complete alternative to voice: private texts, email, meeting chat and anonymous complaints.
howto.3.title: Company and career
howto.3.text: Reach the target and everyone gets +75; not fired +100, secret objective +60, Employee of the Month +40. Each proven sabotage costs -50. Ranks follow career points; money is not points.
howto.4.title: Blame, warnings, final vote
howto.4.text: Blame is a public record. Daily ballots include 'No action'; a warning needs at least two votes. In the final meeting everyone defends; someone is fired only with more than half of the voters.
howto.5.title: Evidence
howto.5.text: Records (phone, bank, task, IT, badge, HR) are authenticated game facts. A record you present is shown to everyone; the actor of a proven sabotage gets -50 points and +2 blame. Accusations, complaints and votes are not proof.
howto.6.title: Recordings and privacy
howto.6.text: If the host allows it, 7-second excerpts of calls are played in meetings; they stay in memory and never reach disk. Playtest data consent is separate: Settings > Privacy.
